spec: Heavy goods carried by hand (sim/carry.ts). One load at a time, drawn on the player and slowing them. loads: itemId (items.json), name of the load, qty units per trip, speed (walk multiplier while carried), shape (carry-draw art: logs, stones, sack, ore, bale, bolts, crate), resource (the LOD resource a facility/wagon pile draws from; default the item's economyResourceId). offcutOf: a yard that makes none of this load's own resource still stacks it from the offcuts of that one (half its output, rounded up): a lumber camp that only saws timber keeps a firewood heap. facilityPiles: facility kind -> load item ids its yard stacks. townPiles: load item ids a town's stock shows as piles by the hearth (wool and cloth are here because no facility yard or wagon carries cloth, so a weaver's bolts would otherwise never be lifted). thanks: what a delivery that helps someone (their plan, or a town short of it) earns: trust on the person, a coin tip from the carryRewardCoin deeds row, and how many dawns the thanks line keeps.
